name: vsblender
description: Set up Blender for AI clients, ingest .blend files into readable notes, and drive Blender through a local MCP server and add-on: model with a geometry kit, check models for render, games or 3D printing, and export 3MF, STL, GLB and more.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: VSBlender starts Blender with the executable named in .blender-ai/config.json and ingests .blend files when a folder opens, so it only runs in trusted folders.

vsblender.showSetupOnStartup.description: Open the setup wizard when a workspace with a .blend file has not been configured yet.

vsblender.autoIngest.description: Ingest .blend files when the workspace opens and when a .blend file is saved.

vsblender.ingestPreviews.description: Render the overview previews during ingest. Turn this off for a faster structural ingest.

vsblender.port.description: Localhost port the Blender add-on listens on. Default shown in the setup wizard.

vsblender.blenderPath.description: Optional path to blender.exe. Leave empty to use the path saved by the setup wizard.

vsblender.replaceLegacy.description: When setup runs, remove MCP entries whose command is mcp-for-blender. Other servers are left alone.

vsblender.clients.claude.description: Default for the setup wizard: write .mcp.json, CLAUDE.md, and Claude permission rules (read-only VSBlender tools allowed, .blend files denied).

vsblender.clients.vscode.description: Default for the setup wizard: write .vscode/mcp.json and .github/copilot-instructions.md.

vsblender.clients.grok.description: Default for the setup wizard: write .grok/config.toml. Grok reads CLAUDE.md, so a second copy of the guide is not written while Claude Code is enabled.

vsblender.clients.cursor.description: Default for the setup wizard: write .cursor/mcp.json and .cursorrules. Off unless you turn it on.

vsblender.clients.cline.description: Default for the setup wizard: write .cline/mcp.json and .clinerules. Off unless you turn it on.
